source_issue.title: Video block: YouTube playlist URL without a video id shows a broken placeholder image

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue concerns a bug in the Video block of Volto where a YouTube playlist URL, lacking a video ID, displays a broken placeholder image. When users attempt to access such a URL, they see an invalid thumbnail instead of a suitable default image.

## What needs to be done
The current code needs a fix to ensure that if a playlist URL is provided without a video ID, an appropriate placeholder image (like only a play icon) is shown instead of the broken image. Additionally, some dead code related to the `listID` prop should be removed for clarity.

## Helpful background
The bug arises from the `getVideoIDAndPlaceholder` function in `Body.jsx`, which incorrectly generates a thumbnail URL that results in a `null` value when there is no video ID. This issue is consistent in both the current and previous versions of the code, indicating it is not a new regression.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the `getVideoIDAndPlaceholder` function in `packages/volto/src/components/manage/Blocks/Video/Body.jsx`.
2. Review how the thumbnail URL is constructed and identify where the appropriate placeholder logic can be added.
3. Propose an update to the code and remove the unnecessary `listID` prop.
4. Consider testing your changes to ensure the new placeholder displays correctly and the video plays as expected.
```
